remarks: Vibrant Downtown Stamford living! Just steps from shopping, dining, and a short walk to the train, this prime location offers it all! Nestled in the sought-after Forest Square condo complex, located on a quiet cul-de-sac. This remodeled move-in ready 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath condo boasts a modern kitchen, updated baths, hardwood floors, & decorative crown molding throughout. Looking for outdoor space, enjoy two private balconies, perfect for your morning coffee. The unit also comes with two storage units, providing plenty of extra space. With low HOA fees, new central air and heat, and an attached one-car garage, this condo leaves nothing to do but move in and enjoy. Ample visitor parking makes entertaining easy.  Don't miss this opportunity to live in one of Stamford's most desirable Downtown locations!   My seller respectfully requests all offers be submitted by 7 pm October 6 th . Thank you to everyone for your interest ! Please reach out with any questions!
